brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net make a site to take a post and tally how many times all persons are mentioned under it. If it's not the root post also have another column with number of mentions under root but sort first by the number of mentions under the specific post. Do double count for double mention.

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@syntax.fm: We have $100K to give away to open source maintainers! Let us know your suggestions and nominations.
@pds.dad: Whipped up a little tool to count mentions in a post if it'll help any.

(my vote is for @bad-example.com, @43081j.com, and @e18e.dev)

whos-tagged.up.railway.app?post=https%3...
  [image, alt text: shows a webpage with the top "They emntioned @43081j.com how many times??" then shows a profile card for them. after that it's an input for a bluesky post and shows the post with each person and how many times someone was mentioned]
@jauntywunderkind.bsky.social: Excellently networked, on the spot.

[from the harness, not the requester] 1 image from this thread is attached to this build as a file — you can see it. If someone asks whether you can see their screenshot, the answer is yes.

[from the harness, not the requester] These images were in the thread but could
NOT be downloaded, so you do NOT have them. Don't describe or guess at their
contents. If they matter to the request, say in your reply that you couldn't
fetch them and ask for a description.
- https://cdn.bsky.app/img/feed_fullsize/plain/did:plc:rnpkyqnmsw4ipey6eotbdnnf/bafkreiaarphzbvkfarhfmhlzmtlbcdfesz4rgjdpa63ny4ednhncjwt2ge (came back as , not an image)
note: Paste a post and get a tally of everyone @-mentioned in its replies (repeats counted). On a reply there's a second column for mentions under the thread root, sorted by this post first.
